headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins 13-1, behind a standout performance from their offense.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Chicago White Sox right-handed pitcher Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants have transferred third baseman Matt Chapman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The Boston Red Sox have placed right-handed pitcher Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have placed center fielder James Outman on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion and left fielder Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed catcher Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to left hip inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a trade involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Marlins 13-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 13-1 victory over the Miami Marlins, behind a standout performance from their offense. Rafael Flores Jr. led the charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Yankees in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 win over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert pitching 6.0 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **White Sox RHP Davis Martin Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox right-handed pitcher Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
